The winning team comprised Nivitha S, Lakshmi Priya, Mohamed Shami, Sadia Mohamed Ali, and Bharathi Kannan, who impressed the judges with their consistency and teamwork through every stage of the competition.The victory at CASE Storm stands as a testament to the analytical rigour and presentation skills nurtured within the department, reflecting well on the institution's broader academic training. 18 LEARN.
